events.description: QEHS House Drama competition, "A Christmas Carol". Elgar perform 5th of 6 houses. Francis can either stay in school (register with House Leader by 15:40, Sixth Form Hall, then Maths corridor 16:30) or go home and return by 16:30. Results announced ~20:15 — if Francis is staying under House Leader supervision afterwards, Jess (or a named adult) must collect him in person from the Upper School Hall at ~20:15 and sign him out; if he's allowed to leave on his own, no sign-out needed. Jess needs to submit a preference form by 09:00 that morning (separate calendar entry) saying which option applies.
